concept: Goals model r3 D1–D12/E1–E6; AEON-1452 r5 series addendum

implementation.list: One page-wide MATERIALIZED invoker expansion statement for up to 100 goals; shared work scope, distinct leaf facts and eta.AggregateScopeSQL, plus batched history, badges and waits. Full-filter totals and computed sorting use bounded batches across at most 1000 candidates.
implementation.paging: Union budgets of 4096 roots/50000 root-node pairs shrink the page with truncated=true and a filter-bound keyset cursor. Savepoint retries reuse already visibility-filtered counts and known failed work-root sets. A singleton above its budget remains counts-only too_large while siblings expand; totals_partial exposes omitted derived totals.
implementation.r5: goals/1.4 adds changed_keys and retains keys/keys_truncated. Visible outcome/ticket state transitions are listed even when pct stays unchanged. Delta compares the preceding bucket, including the exact first-bucket boundary. Event-backed 24 hourly/28 six-hour/30 daily buckets and inclusive four-hour stall remain.
implementation.safety_fixes: Invoker visibility uses identity lookups instead of recursively hashing unrelated outcomes. The original non-outcome shortcut is retained. Scheduled revalidation uses workerCtx/background pool admission. Scoped node walks share child visibility setup. Reapplying released migration 1241 preserves the current later Goals event policy within the same DDL transaction.
